configure_mask_rcnn_xcit_backbone: configure a mask R-CNN model with XCiT small 12-layer patch-8 backbone for COCO instance segmentation
define_train_pipeline_augmentation: define a training data pipeline with autoaugment, random flip, resize, and normalize for instance segmentation
configure_adamw_optimizer: configure an AdamW optimizer with custom weight decay keys for absolute position embed and norm layers
setup_fp16_distributed_training: setup mixed-precision distributed training with epoch-based runner for 36 epochs on COCO dataset
configure_roi_head_extractors: configure ROI head with SingleRoIExtractor and RoIAlign layers for bounding box and mask prediction
